title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today's biggest golf stories.

items.headline: Nelly Korda Headlines Evian
items.text: Nelly Korda leads a loaded field at the LPGA Amundi Evian Championship in France, a major event with a scenic setting.

items.headline: Rahm’s Scottish Open Return
items.text: Jon Rahm plays the 2026 Genesis Scottish Open after settling DP World Tour fines; a win here wouldn’t restore his PGA Tour status.

items.headline: Hovland Backs Ryder Cup Picks
items.text: Viktor Hovland says Jon Rahm and Tyrrell Hatton are crucial for Europe’s 2027 Ryder Cup team after they paid fines and met eligibility requirements.
